truth_boundary: Public proof communicates evidence already produced by canonical systems. It does not manufacture production, customer, payment or revenue status.

proof_classes.meaning: Demonstration or prototype evidence only; not proof of production use or customer payment.
Code/configuration exists with traceable implementation evidence; deployment is not implied.
Deployment and health evidence exist for the stated environment/time window.
A delivery occurred under an applicable customer/commercial basis; private details remain redacted or consent-controlled.
Externally settled and reconciled commercial evidence exists; public disclosure still requires privacy/contract permission.

rules: Never publish secrets, private customer data, unrestricted internal logs or unsupported financial claims.
A demo must be labeled as a demo.
A merged change does not imply deployed or healthy state.
A checkout, invoice or test payment does not imply verified revenue.
Culture/IP proof should expose provenance or attribution summaries where commercially relevant and permitted.
